interactions.note: The apparent dissociation constant for 304M3-B Fab bound to the epitope was determined in a peptide immunoprecipitation assay. The binding parameters varied depending on whether the peptide or antibody was immobilized. Analysis of soluble antibodies bound to immobilized peptide indicated cooperative binding. Modifications on neighboring residues had modest effects on the binding affinity. Alanine substitution of light chain residues D51 in CDRL1 and D53 in CDRL2, which form a binding pocket, abolished binding to the epitope. Antibody residues W33, Y58, W100b in the heavy chain and W91 and Y96 in the light chain also constitute an aromatic cage important for binding, as shown by alanine substitution analysis. A long-neck scFv-Fc construct with the scFv connected to an Fc with a 17-residue linker bound to the epitope with KD =10 nM.
The epitope-specific antibody 304M3-B recognized histone H3 in Western blots of whole cell extracts (K562 cells or yeast).

The epitope-specific antibody 304M3-B displayed on phage bound to the epitope by ELISA. Alanine substitution of light chain residues D51 in CDRL1 and D53 in CDRL2, which form a binding pocket, abolished binding to the epitope. Antibody residues W33, Y58, W100b in the heavy chain and W91 and Y96 in the light chain also constitute an aromatic cage important for binding, as shown by alanine substitution analysis.

The epitope specific antibody 304M3-B immunostained histone H3 in NIH 3T3 cells. A long-neck scFv-Fc construct with the scFv connected to an Fc with a 17-residue linker was used. The 304M3-B long-neck scFv-Fc antibody showed a punctate pattern and localized in regions where H3K9me3 is enriched.

The apparent dissociation constant for 309M3-B Fab bound to the epitope was determined in a peptide immunoprecipitation assay. The binding parameters varied depending on whether the peptide or antibody was immobilized. Analysis of soluble antibodies bound to immobilized peptide indicated cooperative binding. A long-neck scFv-Fc construct with the scFv connected to an Fc with a 17-residue linker did not show strong cooperativity whereas the IgG did. The effects of modifications on neighboring residues on binding affinity were analyzed. Phosphorylation of Thr6 had the largest effect, increasing the KD by1000-fold. The epitope specific antibody 309M3-B immunostained histone H3 in NIH 3T3 cells. A long-neck scFv-Fc construct with the scFv connected to an Fc with a 17-residue linker was used. The 309M3-B long-neck scFv-Fc antibody showed a punctate pattern where the foci overlapped with those of the DAPI staining, indicating that 309M3-B  long-neck scFv-Fc antibody was concentrated in the pericentric heterochromatin region where H3K9me3 is enriched.
